system.description:
Trigger: You are targeted by an ability with an Attack Roll.

Roll a Dodge as normal as part of this skill and you gain a +1 bonus to this roll. On a success, the Attacker is convinced they have struck you as a fake shell of you falls over. Choose a spot within 6 Spaces and blink there, afterwards make a Quick Attack with a +2 bonus to Attack Roll and a +1 bonus to your Base Damage.
